alignments.note: Finite verb with its fronted auxiliary; discontinuous around the subject (rules 17, 25).

One English compound word renders the construct pair *heels of horse*, so rule 30's condition is met; the supplied *the* joins the nominal expression (rule 15). Head on the construct noun, which is the phrase's head (rule 23).
מִן rendered *By reason of*, headed on the content word the phrase turns on (rule 24).
Second occurrence, separately rendered; supplied *the* joins the noun (rule 15).
Nomen rectum takes *of*; *ones* is the supplied generic and *strong* carries the lexeme (rules 19, 31).
Suffix realized by the possessive *their*, the ASV's pronoun not agreeing in number with the suffix (rule 18).

review_notes: *horsehoofs* is treated as one rule 30 fusion of עִקְּבֵי סוּס rather than leaving one member unrepresented.
